svg.title: One Periodic Update Graph refresh cycle
svg.desc: A refresh cycle starts by refreshing the independent source tables A, B, and C. Derived tables A2 and A3 depend on A, B2 on B, and C2 and C3 on C. Table BC depends on B2 and C2. The cycle ends when every notification is processed.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
